name: Anant Raj Estate Residences
summary: The project, developer (Anant Raj Limited), Sector 63A location, RERA GGM/785/517/2024/12 dated 09.02.2024 (confirmed on HARERA), 5.5 acres, 4 towers, 248 units and 4 BHK sizes from 3,610 sq ft are confirmed. The December 2027 completion matches the HARERA-cited date and a broker, but Square Yards lists possession as March 2030. The starting price is within range of one broker (₹7.22 Cr), while Square Yards' current listing starts at ₹8.90 Cr; Square Yards also lists 292 units.

Expected completion December 2027 (LuxuryResidences; HRERA-cited per search results); possession March 2030 (Square Yards)
checks.note: Sources disagree by over two years. The HARERA page fetched did not show the completion date, so Dec 2027 could not be confirmed directly on the portal. A Dec 2027 completion looks optimistic for 30–32 floor towers registered in Feb 2024. Consider showing both dates.

checks.web: ₹7.22 Cr onwards (LuxuryResidences); ~₹6.5 Cr onwards (broker search snippet); ₹8.90 Cr – ₹11.47 Cr at ₹24,000/sq ft (Square Yards)
checks.note: Within ±15% of the broker launch prices (₹7.22 Cr is +8%), but Square Yards' current starting price is ~33% higher. Our price looks like a stale launch price.
